erlotinib_gaff2.xml.molecule: erlotinib (PDB ligand AQ4), neutral, coordinates from PDB 1M17, H added by RDKit

alanine_dipeptide_phi_psi.csv.ensemble: NVT, LangevinMiddleIntegrator 300 K, friction 1/ps, 2 fs, HBonds constraints, no cutoff

chignolin.system: CLN025 chignolin variant YYDPETGTWY, PDB 5AWL chain A, prepared with PDBFixer, H added at pH 7
chignolin.solvent: TIP3P-FB water, 1.0 nm padding, cubic box, 0.15 M NaCl
chignolin.protocol: minimize; 20 ps NVT + 20 ps NPT with 400 kJ/mol/nm2 heavy-atom restraints; production NPT
chignolin.integrator: LangevinMiddleIntegrator 300 K, 1/ps, 4 fs, HBonds constraints, hydrogen mass 1.5 amu (HMR)
chignolin.command: CHIGNOLIN_REPLICA=<i> CHIGNOLIN_NS=0.2 CHIGNOLIN_EQ_PS=20 OPENMM_CPU_THREADS=1 python scripts/generate_trajectories.py chignolin; then merge_chignolin
chignolin.files: chignolin_protein.pdb (topology), chignolin_rep*.dcd (protein only, superposed on frame 0), chignolin_thermo.csv
chignolin.atoms_note: each replica was solvated independently; OpenMM addSolvent gave slightly different numbers of water molecules

egfr_erlotinib.system: EGFR kinase domain (PDB 1M17 chain A residues 672-964, unresolved N-terminal tag not built) + erlotinib (AQ4)
egfr_erlotinib.solvent: TIP3P-FB water, 1.0 nm padding, truncated octahedron, 0.15 M NaCl
egfr_erlotinib.protocol: minimize; 15 ps NVT + 15 ps NPT with 400 kJ/mol/nm2 restraints on solute heavy atoms; production NPT
egfr_erlotinib.integrator: LangevinMiddleIntegrator 300 K, 1/ps, 4 fs, HBonds constraints, hydrogen mass 1.5 amu (HMR)
egfr_erlotinib.files: egfr_erlotinib_complex.pdb (topology, solute only), egfr_erlotinib.dcd (solute only, superposed on protein CA)
